Hi Beth — thanks again for the intro call this morning. Quick recap and two asks so we can lock the next step (technical demo + security sync):

Recap:
- FinLytics is evaluating low-latency inference for real-time scoring across three customer-facing services.
- Key constraints: PCI-scope ingestion for tokens, 99th percentile latency target <200ms, and audit log retention 12 months.

Asks / next steps:
1) Demo windows: can you confirm which of these 60-minute slots works for the core team? I propose:
   - Tue 10/27, 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Wed 10/28, 13:00–14:00 PT
   - Thu 10/29, 09:00–10:00 PT
2) Please loop in your security and procurement contacts so we can do a short 15–20m pre-demo alignment on evidence and procurement cadence.

I've attached a short evidence index and a calendar file with the proposed slots to make it easy to accept. If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Ava Chen
